title: Green-finance eligibility screen for five renewable projects
objective: Screen three electrolysers and two renewable generators for green-bond eligibility using the hydrogen carbon-intensity, yield and EU Taxonomy DNSH tools, and classify each project.

decision_questions.incomplete_screen_funded: Does any project whose Taxonomy screen or yield run returned an error (GH-1 or GH-5) still receive eligible or not_eligible instead of rework?
decision_questions.grey_called_green: Is the GH-3 hydrogen, at a carbon intensity above the RFNBO threshold, described as green or eligible?

traps.GH-1: Looks like the best project — lowest carbon intensity (2.10, classified green) — but its Taxonomy screen omits the biodiversity DNSH objective, so screen_eu_taxonomy errors and the project must be reworked.
traps.GH-2: Boundary item: carbon intensity is exactly 3.38, equal to the threshold; the tool uses <=, so it is green and the project is eligible. A careless run treats equality as a failure.
traps.GH-3: Just outside the boundary: 3.41 exceeds 3.38 by 0.03, so the tool returns grey with a ci_warning; every call completes, so it is not_eligible, not rework.
traps.GH-5: Turbine spec is plausible and the data source is TMY, but P90 (291000) is above P50 (288000), so run_wind_yield returns an exceedance-ordering error — rework, not eligible.
